note: REFUGIO's model catalog. Settings > Models > 'Check for better models' fetches this file from the branch you installed, so a newly-rated model reaches people WITHOUT them updating REFUGIO. scripts/mem-fit.cjs stays the installer's source of truth and the fallback when this file cannot be reached; entries here add to that ladder and override its figures by tag.

fields.tag: Ollama model name, with an explicit size tag. Required.
fields.ramGb: Approximate resident RAM under Ollama at Q4 with a modest KV cache. Required.
fields.tools: Can it drive REFUGIO's connectors at all? Required, boolean. This is the gate the whole product hangs on.
fields.nativeTools: Can it drive Open WebUI's native function calling, as opposed to OWUI's prompt-based mode?
fields.rank: Hand-assigned capability score, higher is better. Independent of ramGb — that is the point: a newer small model can outrank an older large one. Built-in ladder entries are 10, 20, 30... so a catalog entry can land between them.
fields.verified: Has someone actually watched this model call a REFUGIO connector? Unverified models are listed and downloadable, and are NEVER recommended.
fields.estimated: Optional, default false. TRUE means nobody has measured ramGb — it was inferred from the download size or otherwise guessed. Settings then shows the figure with a ~ and says so on hover, instead of presenting a guess as a measurement. Set it honestly: an entry that omits this is claiming the number was measured.
fields.note: One line shown next to the model in Settings.
fields.added: When this entry was added to the catalog.

models.note: Chats. Ignores its tool list and asks you to paste the data in.
Fast, and cannot reach your connectors.
The floor: the smallest model observed to enumerate its tools and call the right one.
The first tier that drives Open WebUI's native function calling.
Qwen3 advertises tool calling at 4B. Listed so it can be tried; not yet observed calling a REFUGIO connector, so it is never recommended. Flip verified to true once it has been.

Liquid's edge MoE (8B total, ~1B active), built for tool calling on consumer hardware; 125K context. RAM measured 2026-09-16 on an Apple M4 Pro / 24 GB, macOS 26.7, Ollama 0.34.1: 5.3 GB resident, 100% GPU, at REFUGIO's 4096-token context — a longer context raises it. Needs Ollama 0.34+ to pull at all; older runtimes are refused with HTTP 412. Watched driving memory__memory_search in eval b2-voice-from-memory.

Gemma 4 with native function calling (4.5B effective, 128K context). RAM measured 2026-09-16 on an Apple M4 Pro / 24 GB, macOS 26.7, Ollama 0.34.1: 9.5 GB resident, 100% GPU, at REFUGIO's 4096-token context — a longer context raises it. Needs Ollama 0.34+ to pull at all; older runtimes are refused with HTTP 412. Watched driving memory__memory_search in eval f1-memory-recall and b2-voice-from-memory.

Meta's 30B agentic model, tuned for tool use and failure recovery; 128K context. RAM measured 2026-09-16 on an Apple M4 Pro / 24 GB, macOS 26.7, Ollama 0.34.1: 17 GB resident, but only 86% of it on the GPU — 14% ran on CPU at the default wired limit (iogpu.wired_limit_mb=0, ~18 GB of 24). Not a clean GPU-resident figure. Tool calls were correct but 4-8x slower than the smaller two. Needs Ollama 0.34+ to pull at all. Watched driving memory__memory_search in eval f1-memory-recall and b2-voice-from-memory.
